mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of the foreign shareholder/investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent corporate registry in the foreign investor's home jurisdiction (e.g., Companies House, Hong Kong Companies Registry, Delaware Secretary of State)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille path: issue the certificate at the home registry and obtain an Apostille from the home jurisdiction's designated competent authority; no further consular legalization is required. Non-Hague path: notarize at home and legalize at the PRC Embassy/Consulate having consular jurisdiction; the two paths are parallel and mutually exclusive and must never be chained sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (Certificate of Incumbency if required)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home jurisdiction corporate registry or registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille path: verify at home registry and Apostille. Non-Hague path: notarize and obtain consular legalization from the PRC Embassy/Consulate. Never combine Apostille with consular legalization.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution or Power of Attorney approving the WFOE establishment and appointing the legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors of the foreign shareholder/investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: If issued in an Apostille Convention state, notarize the execution of the resolution and Apostille; if issued in a non-member state, notarize and present to the PRC Embassy/Consulate for consular legalization. Each route is exclusive and complete on its own.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association / Memorandum of Association of the foreign investor (certified copy)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home jurisdiction registrar or the foreign investor's directors (certified as authentic)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille: certify at home and Apostille. Consular legalization: certify at home, notarize, and legalize at the PRC Embassy/Consulate. Do not apply both regimes.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter for the foreign investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign investor's relationship bank in its home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille: signed by the bank officer, apostilled by the competent authority of the home jurisdiction, then accompanied by a certified Chinese translation; no PRC consular legalization. Non-Hague: bank letter must be notarized and consularized by the PRC Embassy/Consulate. Parallel paths only.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Before any incorporation filing, screen each shareholder, ultimate beneficial owner (at least 25% ownership or control), director, supervisor, legal representative, authorized signatory and material agent against the People's Bank of China sanctions and anti-money laundering lists, China's domestic sanctions and anti-terrorism lists, the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list, the UN Security Council Consolidated List, and the EU/UK consolidated sanctions lists. Apply enhanced due diligence for all politically exposed persons (PEPs), including family members and close associates, with senior-management approval, source-of-wealth, source-of-funds and transaction monitoring. Run adverse media screening in both English and Simplified Chinese; investigate shell-company red flags, nominee-UBO arrangements and inconsistent ownership; maintain an audit trail and report suspicious activity to the PBOC Anti-Money Laundering Monitoring and Analysis Center. Retain all records for no less than five years after termination.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Enterprise Registration and Credit Information Publicity System - State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) Enterprise Name Approval and Registration Online Service (China National Enterprise Registration Online Service)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: A mandatory Chinese-language company name is required. The name must follow the four-tier statutory construction: administrative division + distinctive name + industry description + organizational form. The distinctive part must contain at least two Chinese characters; Latin letters, numerals and pinyin are accepted only as auxiliary elements, never as the sole distinctive element. The foreign investor's English name may be phonetically transliterated into Chinese and the Chinese name must be used for all government, tax, bank and contract filings; the English name is supplementary and does not replace the registered Chinese name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the name is rejected, the applicant receives a written notice with reasons from the local market regulation authority. The applicant may file an administrative reconsideration application with the authority's superior market regulation authority within 60 days from receipt of the written rejection, attaching the proposed name, grounds for clearance, prior trademark rights or prior name registration evidence and the relevant approval from any ministry whose sensitive token is involved. Alternatively, the applicant may revise the distinctive element and resubmit a new online name reservation application, as the 30-day reservation window runs from successful approval and does not extend automatically. If the administrative reconsideration decision is unfavorable, judicial review is available before the People's Court within 6 months of service. In practice, preserve all rejection notices, secure ministerial approvals in advance for sensitive tokens, and avoid names identical or confusingly similar to existing registered enterprises within the same administrative region.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office or commercial mailbox is generally disfavored and frequently rejected for a WFOE in the stock photography and generative visual assets industry. The market regulation authority requires a physical registered address in China at which the enterprise can carry out business, accept legal process and be reached for inspection; the tax authority verifies the address separately during taxpayer registration; banks require a physical-office visit, doorplate, lease agreement, utility invoice and staff presence before accepting corporate account documentation. Registration at a virtual mailbox may be accepted only in a narrow pilot/free-trade-zone context under an approved hosting agreement, but most commercial banks will decline KYC approval for such an address. For a low-risk digital-media WFOE, the prudent structure is a dedicated office lease in the same administrative district as the registered address, with the lease filed and, if required, property ownership evidence in the file.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Likelihood: approximately 15-20% probability of an unannounced on-site inspection by the local market regulation bureau or municipal tax bureau within the first 24 months of registration for a low-risk WFOE; probability rises to 50-60% if tax invoices are abnormal, a complaint is filed, the office is entered as a virtual-only address, or the company applies for VAT special invoices. Checklist for inspection readiness: original lease agreement registered with the local housing authority; landlord property ownership certificate; signboard matching the registered Chinese name; staff actually present during business hours; utility bills in the company's name; financial ledgers and vouchers accessible; registered address physically accessible without appointment.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No official registration fee is charged; enterprise registration is budget-funded.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and certified Chinese translation of foreign shareholder's corporate document bundle
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: PRC notary office and certified translation company
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Provincial price bureau notarial schedule and translation market rate per page/set.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille or consular legalization fees for five documentary instruments
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Foreign competent authority for Apostille; PRC Embassy/Consulate for consular legalization
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Consular fee schedule varies by embassy; approximately USD 30-120 per document, plus apostille fee at home jurisdiction.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Landlord or commercial property management company
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark; office lease rates vary and deposits typically equal one to three months' rent.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed milestone fee under engagement letter; prevailing market benchmark of USD 5,000-8,000 for a standard WFOE formation.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for notarization, translation and administrative support materials for corporate account opening.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision, effective 1 July 2024), Articles 23, 32, 42, 47, 49 and 59; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (effective 1 January 2020), Articles 2, 4, 30 and 31; Regulations on the Administration of Foreign-Invested Companies; Interim Measures for the Administration of Filing of Foreign-Invested Information Reporting (Ministry of Commerce Order No. 2, 2020).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Enterprise Registration Bureau of the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and the relevant municipal/provincial Administration for Market Regulation (AMR) where the WFOE is domiciled.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Company Establishment Registration Application Form (foreign-invested limited liability company), including the Articles of Association, Formation Resolution, and Foreign-Investment Information Report.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum or government-blocked escrow account is imposed for a permitted-service WFOE classified under ISIC 7420 / NAICS 541922. Under the 2023 Company Law, the registered capital stated in the Articles of Association is a binding obligation and must be fully paid by the shareholders within five (5) years from the date of issuance of the business license unless a shorter period is stated in the Articles. Capital must be remitted through a licensed bank foreign-exchange capital account, evidenced by injection receipts, and is subject to anti-money-laundering and foreign-exchange consistency screening by the receiving bank.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: PRO-FORMA FIRST BOARD OF DIRECTORS RESOLUTION OF CN_WFOE_LTD (WHOLLY FOREIGN-OWNED ENTERPRISE LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY): The undersigned constituting the first Board of Directors (the 'Board') of CN_WFOE_LTD (the 'Company'), a limited liability company to be established under the laws of the People's Republic of China, have convened and hereby unanimously adopt the following resolutions effective as of the date below. 1. SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION. RESOLVED, that the registered capital of the Company shall be the amount set forth in the Articles of Association, divided into limited-liability equity interests in the agreed proportions; that each founding shareholder shall subscribe to the registered capital as recorded in the register of shareholders; that each subscription shall be fully contributed no later than five years from the date of the business license or earlier as required by law or directed by the Board; and that the legal representative shall open a foreign-exchange capital account with a licensed commercial bank and cause all capital injections to be made and reported in accordance with the foreign exchange regulations of the People's Republic of China. 2. BANKING AUTHORIZATION. RESOLVED, that the Company open and maintain a basic deposit account, general settlement account and foreign-exchange capital account at the banks selected by the Board; and that the legal representative, general manager and chief financial officer, acting jointly or singly as required by the bank mandate forms, are authorized to sign account documents, execute payment instructions, negotiate foreign-exchange filings, and perform all incidental banking acts for and on behalf of the Company. 3. REGISTERED OFFICE ADOPTION. RESOLVED, that the registered office and statutory address of the Company be and hereby is fixed at the address stated in the Articles of Association, and that the legal representative execute the lease, right-to-use or co-occupancy agreement, accept service of process, and register the office address with the competent Administration for Market Regulation. 4. STATUTORY OFFICER APPOINTMENTS. RESOLVED, that the following persons are appointed to the indicated offices: [name], legal representative and executive director; [name], general manager; [name], supervisor; and [name], financial officer, each with the authority, duties, and powers conferred by the Company Law, the Articles of Association, and applicable PRC regulations, and the Board authorizes the legal representative to affix the company seal in the ordinary course of business. 5. GENERAL AUTHORIZATION. RESOLVED, that all acts taken by the incorporators and any powers of attorney delivered prior to this meeting are ratified and approved; and that the legal representative and executive director may execute all registrations, filings, amendments, notices, undertakings, and other instruments as may be necessary or desirable to implement these resolutions. Each of the foregoing resolutions shall remain in full force and effect until amended or revoked by a lawful subsequent resolution of the Board. Dated this ____ day of ____________, 20____. Signed: _________________________ (Chairman/Secretary of the first Board).

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-incorporation name reservation, foreign investor legalization, and negative-list screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Administration for Market Regulation (AMR) of the intended municipality through the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) National Enterprise Registration Online Service Platform
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Counsel must first screen the proposed WFOE business scope against the current Negative List for Foreign Investment Access to confirm that a stock-photography marketplace and generative visual-asset licensing service is an unrestricted or permitted investment area requiring no separate foreign-investment approval. Next, reserve a Chinese company name in the format geographic name plus trade name plus industry designation plus Limited Liability Company, using the AMR online name-preservation module. In parallel, obtain notarized and legalized or apostilled copies of the foreign corporate shareholder's certificate of incorporation and certificate of good standing, or a passport for an individual shareholder, accompanied by a certified Chinese translation. A notarized power of attorney must be executed in favor of the local incorporation agent. The registered capital amount should be calibrated to the company's operating needs and contribution schedule to avoid a challenge by the receiving bank or tax authority.
required_dossiers: Completed Enterprise Name Reservation Application
Draft Articles of Association
Legalized/notarized certificate of incorporation of foreign shareholder or passport
Certificate of good standing, if corporate shareholder
Notarized power of attorney appointing local incorporation agent
Certified Chinese translation of all non-Chinese documents
Statement of proposed business scope consistent with ISIC 7420 / NAICS 541922
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected or conflicts with an existing registration, submit a revised trade name within one working day. If the foreign investor documents are queried, supplement the missing apostille, legalization, notarization, or Chinese translation and re-upload. If negative-list screening identifies a restricted incidental activity, amend the business scope to remove the restricted wording or adjust the corporate structure to comply.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and filing of WFOE establishment registration with the local AMR
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Administration for Market Regulation (AMR) in the city of the registered office, through the SAMR Enterprise Registration Online Service Platform
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After name pre-approval, finalize and execute the Articles of Association, the First Board Resolution, the Formation Resolution, and the appointment letters of the legal representative, executive director, supervisor, and general manager. The executing shareholder signatories must be duly authorized by their own corporate boards, and all signatures must be consistent with the legalized corporate documents. Submit the Company Establishment Registration Application Form to the local AMR, attaching the pre-approval notice, executed Articles of Association, formation and board resolutions, identity documents of the legal representative and supervisor, right-to-use evidence of the registered address, and the legalized investor qualification dossier. The AMR checks the application against the Foreign Investment Law and the Negative List; because the ISIC 7420 service activity is not restricted, no prior Ministry of Commerce license is required, but the AMR may request further proof if any wording implies an activity requiring a sector license. The official registration fee is zero, and the approved WFOE will be issued a Business License under a unified social credit code.
required_dossiers: Company Establishment Registration Application Form
Articles of Association signed by all shareholders
First Board Resolution and Formation Resolution
Name Pre-approval Notice
Legalized investor qualification documents and certified translations
Power of attorney and local agent authorization
Identity certificate of legal representative and supervisor
Registered-office lease agreement, title proof, or landlord consent
Capital contribution schedule or payment plan
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the AMR issues a rectification notice, cure every listed defect through the online portal before the deadline. If a business-scope description is deemed overbroad or inconsistent with registered practice for photography licensing, narrow the description to mirror the ISIC 7420 definition. If the authority insists on a sectoral license, suspend the establishment filing, obtain the license from the applicable ministry, and resubmit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-incorporation seal creation, tax and social-insurance registration, bank account opening, and capital injection
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Security Bureau (seal filing), State Taxation Administration local tax bureau, local human-resources social-insurance bureau, and a People's Bank of China-licensed commercial bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Once the Business License is received, the legal representative or authorized agent shall contract a licensed seal engraver to produce the company seal, legal representative seal, financial seal, and invoice issuance seal, and must file the seal specifications with the Public Security Bureau. The WFOE must then complete tax registration at the local tax bureau, register with social insurance and housing fund authorities if employees are hired, and maintain the required statutory books. Open the basic deposit account at a licensed bank and, simultaneously, apply for a foreign-exchange capital account; the bank will complete the enterprise-level foreign-investment registration with the State Administration of Foreign Exchange. The subscribed capital shall be remitted in accordance with the contribution schedule, accompanied by bank transfer documentation, and funds may be applied to the ordinary and necessary operating expenses of the stock-photo and generative visual-asset platform after the bank's know-your-customer and foreign-exchange verification.
required_dossiers: Original and duplicate Business License
Uniform Social Credit Code certificate
Legal representative identity document
Seal engraving filing receipt and specimen
Articles of Association
Registered-office lease or ownership evidence
Board resolution designating bank account signatories
Foreign-investment capital remittance schedule and source-of-funds documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank declines the account-opening application on unsuitable-activity or capital-sufficiency grounds, revise the capital schedule, provide supporting business contracts, or select a different licensed bank and resubmit. If tax registration is delayed, contact the tax authority promptly to obtain an extension and avoid late-registration penalties; if the seal filing is returned, correct the impressions and refile with the Public Security Bureau.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign investment information reporting, internet-sector filings, and statutory register maintenance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) Foreign Investment Comprehensive Information Management System, State Administration for Foreign Exchange (SAFE), and relevant internet content regulator if an online platform is launched
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: No later than thirty days after establishment or as directed by the shared registration system, ensure the WFOE's foreign-investment information report has been transmitted to MOFCOM through the Foreign Investment Comprehensive Information Management System, including information on the ultimate foreign investor, ownership chain, actual contribution amounts and dates, business scope, and any subsequent changes. Maintain at the registered office a shareholders register, board minutes, and statutory books in Chinese or bilingual form. If the stock-photography or AI visual-asset platform will operate websites or applications in mainland China, acquire the applicable ICP filing or value-added telecom license from the MIIT or provincial communications administration before launch; this is a sectoral online-service authorization and is separate from any industrial operating permit. The legal representative must also ensure that foreign exchange capital settlement records are retained and that the company's business operations correspond to the filed scope and the tax-registration profile.
required_dossiers: Foreign Investment Information Report confirmation from MOFCOM
SAFE/foreign-exchange capital settlement records
Capital injection receipt and bank statements
Statutory registers and board minute book
Articles of Association and amendments register
ICP filing or value-added telecom license application materials, if online platform to be launched
Business scope and actual-operation consistency checklist
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If MOFCOM flags omissions, amend and refile the foreign-investment report within the statutory cure period. If SAFE challenges a capital settlement, submit underlying licensing agreements, platform user terms, and invoices to the bank. If the communications regulator requires additional filings or a license, engage a licensed telecom agent and defer the online launch until the authorization is issued.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable - pure digital service / stock-media marketplace classified under ISIC 7420 and NAICS 541922; no physical manufacturing, chemical, assembly or warehousing establishment.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Applicable - no industrial/manufacturing permit required for the WFOE's principal activities.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Not Applicable - Ministry of Ecology and Environment (PRC) has no permitting role for non-construction digital service businesses; no physical project or fixed production facility is created.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Not Applicable - exempt from environmental impact assessment reporting, environmental registration, and pollution-discharge permitting under the PRC Environmental Impact Assessment Law because the business does not construct or operate an industrial project.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not Applicable - no wastewater, volatile organic compounds (VOC), particulate, hazardous waste, or noise discharges are generated by stock-photography licensing and AI-assisted visual media operations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not Applicable - no Civil Defense fire permit, structural load inspection, or occupation-health clearance applies to a purely digital office/consulting operation. A standard office workplace must comply with general fire-safety measures of the building management and local fire-rescue rules, but no separate Civil Defense industrial permit is required.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China; taxpayer services and filings are administered through the National Unified Electronic Tax Service Platform (e-Tax) operated by provincial-level STA offices, with cross-entity data exchanges among the STA, the General Administration of Customs (GACC), and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Upon incorporation of the WFOE, the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) issues the business license bearing the Unified Social Credit Code (USCC), which is the statutory TIN/VAT ID for all Chinese tax purposes. Tax registration is integrated into the one-stop market entity registration procedure; the WFOE must finalize its taxpayer profile with the competent local STA office within 30 days of license issuance, including general or small-scale VAT taxpayer classification, tax calculation method, banking information, and activation of the electronic invoice service. For a foreign non-resident enterprise that does not establish a Chinese legal entity but derives China-source income, the non-resident taxpayer identification number must be applied for through the competent STA office directly or through a withholding agent before filing, paying tax, or claiming treaty benefits; this limited registration does not create a permanent establishment solely by itself.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation - China taxes a WFOE as a resident enterprise on worldwide income under the Enterprise Income Tax Law and does not permit pass-through treatment to foreign shareholders.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None - China does not provide a check-the-box or hybrid mismatch entity classification election. A WFOE cannot elect pass-through taxation; VAT general taxpayer status is a turnover-based registrable status, not an income tax entity election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No turnover threshold applies for basic tax registration of an incorporated WFOE; under the VAT regime, an enterprise must register as a General VAT taxpayer when annual taxable sales exceed RMB 5,000,000 in any rolling 12-month period. A small-scale taxpayer with monthly taxable sales of RMB 100,000 or below may be eligible for the prevailing small-scale VAT exemption policy.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: China mandates electronic invoice issuance through the STA unified e-invoice platform. The WFOE must use the All-Electronic Invoice (Full Digital Invoice) system, which requires API-based submission to the STA e-invoice service platform, anti-counterfeit tax-control digital signatures, QR codes, and Golden Tax System verification. Special VAT invoices must be reported and cross-matched before a customer may claim input VAT credits; export-related invoices and customs export declarations are reconciled through the national customs-tax data exchange.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: China zero-rates qualifying exports of goods and cross-border taxable services. For the stock-photo/generative visual-asset business, zero-rating or VAT exemption is available where the digital/licensed content is supplied to an overseas recipient, consumed entirely outside the People's Republic of China, and the service type is included in the STA published catalogue of zero-rated or VAT-exempt cross-border services. The WFOE must be a General VAT taxpayer, maintain a proper input VAT chain, evidence actual performance abroad, and repatriate or collect cross-border settlement proceeds within the statutory period; services not satisfying the consumption-outside-China test are subject to the domestic VAT service rate, which for this entity is generally 6%.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Export Bill of Entry) filed with the General Administration of Customs for physical goods
Bill of Lading, Air Waybill, or equivalent transport document evidencing physical export
Foreign Exchange Receipt Confirmation / Bank Inward Remittance Certificate (the China bank equivalent of an Inward Remittance Certificate, FIRC) evidencing payment by the overseas buyer
Export invoice issued through the STA e-invoice platform
For digital stock-photo and licensing services: service agreement, licensing records, platform usage logs, and evidence that the service is consumed and used outside China
STA export tax refund / zero-rating declaration data transmitted through the e-Tax portal
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The STA, GACC, and SAFE cross-match customs declarations, e-invoices, foreign-exchange receipts, contracts, and service-consumption evidence. Export zero-rating claims with missing documentation, inconsistent customs data, unverified foreign-exchange repatriation, or false digital-service export characterizations are disallowed and clawed back, with VAT at the domestic rate re-asserted, a late-payment surcharge of 0.05% per day, and administrative penalties ranging from 50% to 500% of the tax underpaid or evaded under the Law of the People's Republic of China on the Administration of Tax Collection. Serious cases involving fraudulent export rebates or counterfeit VAT invoices may constitute criminal liability under the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China and may result in loss of export-tax-rebate eligibility, customs sanctions, and inclusion in the serious tax violation blacklist.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBOC) and State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: China's RMB is not fully freely convertible; the PBOC/SAFE maintain a managed floating exchange rate with a daily central parity band. Current account items such as trade in goods, royalty payments and dividend remittances are convertible on a bona fide basis, subject to the purpose and truthfulness examination performed by designated banks. Capital account transactions remain controlled. Inbound equity funding for a WFOE requires FDI registration with SAFE, an approved foreign exchange capital account, and compliance with the special-purpose use rules; foreign exchange cannot be used for domestic equity investment outside the negative list. Export earnings are repatriated into a domestic foreign-currency account and may be retained or converted, eliminating the old mandatory surrender regime, but the bank and SAFE monitor the trade flow for discrepancy. Dividend remittance to the foreign parent is permitted where the WFOE has accumulated distributable profits verified by audit, the relevant corporate income tax and 10% withholding tax are settled, a tax redemption certificate is produced, and no prior AML/SAFE penalty remains outstanding. In practice, the bank also demands board dividend resolutions, the latest annual audited statements, and evidence that the underlying revenues are derived from permissible licensed or unlicensed digital content transactions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export receipts must be brought onshore within 180 days of the customs declaration date, or for cross-border digital services and licensed stock photo income, within the contractually agreed service performance window recognized by SAFE. There is no mandatory conversion ratio currently imposed: the WFOE may retain 100% of export foreign-currency receipts in a domestic foreign-currency account, or convert them into CNY at a designated bank. SAFE and the bank reconcile each receipt using the cross-border receipts and payments system, and any discrepancy exceeding 10% against the underlying invoice triggers submission of supplementary evidence.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: In-depth feasibility is Low for any foreign or offshore digital EMI that seeks to act as the WFOE's primary banking or domestic RMB clearing channel. Stripe, PayPal, and similar EMIs do not hold a PBOC payment institution license and are not legally permitted to open onshore RMB settlement accounts or complete CNY clearing in mainland China. These rails may be used only as an offshore collection conduit for inbound B2C earnings from overseas customers, with the funds periodically swept into a Tier-1 corporate foreign-currency account. AWFOE relying solely on such an EMI would create substantial KYC opacity, high transaction-splitting risk, and potential suspension under PBOC anti-money laundering sanctions. Therefore, the compliant blueprint is Tier-1 banking as the primary treasury spine, with EMI rails confined to foreign customer payment aggregation and limited by contractual terms acceptable to the Chinese settlement bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For WFOE account onboarding in Mainland China, the legal representative or statutory director is generally required to appear physically at the bank branch for the initial KYC interview. Remote consular proxy opening is available only in narrow circumstances where the legal representative executes a notarized and consular-legalized power of attorney, the bank completes a live video verification, and the branch accepts a digital identity certificate. In practice, physical presence is still mandated by most Tier-1 banks for the first account activation; the local finance manager may appear together with the legal representative if the notarized power of attorney and the corporate approval minutes are presented. Without this, the account application will be rejected at the head-office compliance review stage.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity: the offshore parent chain may conceal the ultimate individual controllers, triggering enhanced due diligence and account-refusal risk if the corporate structure crosses multiple jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A notarized and apostilled copy of the parent company register, a mainland-format UBO declaration naming every individual with 25% or greater control, certified passports of those individuals, recent bank reference letters for each shareholder, and source-of-wealth documentation supporting the investment capital.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume micro-transaction flows from a stock photography marketplace may resemble split-transaction structuring or shadow PayPal/Stripe settlement without a visible underlying trade contract.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A monthly marketplace payout report signed by the platform operator, a granular transaction ledger showing sale ID, buyer country, license fee, timestamp, and delivery metadata hash, CPA-attested revenue reconciliation, and a written explanation of the API settlement stack and payment gateway.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Outbound royalty payments to overseas photographers and content creators may be misclassified as capital flight if the payee names do not match registered copyright owners or the underlying license agreements are not available.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Copyright registration certificates, non-exclusive and exclusive license agreements, model releases, influencer permission forms, board-approved disbursement minutes, beneficiary identity confirmation, and non-resident withholding tax payment receipts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unpaid registered capital or mixed-source capital injection could indicate round-tripping or illegal foreign exchange arbitrage, especially if inbound funds originate from an offshore shell or same-side financial accommodation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SAFE FDI registration form, an independent CPA capital verification report issued within six months, overseas bank vouchers and source-of-funds statements, shareholder board minutes authorizing the injection, and a legal declaration confirming that funds represent genuine retained earnings of the overseas parent.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The overseas parent must first complete SAFE Foreign Direct Investment registration. Capital should be remitted via SWIFT MT103 to the WFOE's designated foreign-currency capital account at a Tier-1 bank, with the beneficiary reference including the WFOE registered name and tax identification number, and the payment purpose code expressly marked as FDI equity injection. Upon receipt, the bank verifies the FDI payment control table and may release the funds for permitted operating use after settlement into RMB. A licensed Chinese CPA must issue a capital verification report within six months, and all disbursements must be retained for inspection. The WFOE may not use the injected capital for domestic securities, entrusted loans, or real estate unless the investment falls squarely within the applicable free-trade-zone negative-list exemption.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For licensing fees, royalty distributions and micro-payments to overseas photographers and creators, the WFOE should issue SWIFT MT103 remittances through the Tier-1 bank after presenting invoice, license code, digital delivery confirmation and tax withholding certificate. Current-account payments are processed automatically after the bank completes authenticity screening, without a separate SAFE pre-approval. For high-value content acquisitions, a commercial letter of credit may be opened at the WFOE's bank with presentation of technical acceptance certificates, delivery manifests and invoice match. Documentary collections are acceptable where no LC is needed, provided the transaction is backed by electronic delivery records, order number and contract clauses. Underlying clearing uses domestic RMB clearing via CNAPS, foreign-currency settlement via SWIFT, and cross-border RMB clearing via CIPS where the counterparty bank participates.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable CNY/USD FX forward contracts with a licensed settlement bank, executed to hedge genuine underlying royalty, trade or service payment exposures and evidenced by the relevant contract and invoice

Cross-currency FX swaps and currency swaps permissible only when the hedge corresponds to an actual cross-border funding liability or current-account cash flow of the WFOE and remains within the bank's approved derivative limits
Nonexchange-traded and exchange-traded FX options are permitted only as a hedge for documented commercial exposure, not for speculative margin trading

Boundary statement: non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are generally not permissible for the onshore WFOE; if an offshore parent uses an NDF, the transaction must be booked entirely outside the Chinese entity and must not create economic exposure on the WFOE's balance sheet

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Information Publicity Report (Annual Report)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually from 1 January to 30 June for the preceding fiscal year ending 31 December
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Inclusion in the Operating Abnormal List; if not rectified within 10 days of the written reminder, sustained non-compliance for 3 consecutive years triggers inclusion in the Serious Illegal Enterprise List; legal representative and responsible management become subject to disqualification and travel/credit restrictions; administrative fines of up to RMB 30,000.00 may be imposed for refusal to comply or for falsifying disclosures.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax Annual Final Settlement and Filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) / local tax authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before 31 May following the tax year end (5-month statutory settlement period after 31 December)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment surcharge equal to 0.05% of unpaid tax for each day overdue; administrative penalty of 50% to 100% of the tax amount understated or evaded if deliberate or negligent conduct is found; possible compulsory enforcement against bank accounts and assets following non-payment.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) through the Foreign Investment Information Reporting System consolidated with the SAMR annual report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually from 1 January to 30 June for the preceding fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative order to rectify; failure to file or intentionally making false statements attracts a fine ranging from RMB 10,000.00 to RMB 30,000.00; non-filing may also result in inclusion in the enterprise abnormal operations list and adverse credit records.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Statutory Audit Report of Financial Statements by a Licensed CPA Firm
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) as an integral component of the annual report; audit engagement performed by an approved Chinese public accounting firm
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 May or, in any event, strictly before the closing of the 30 June annual-report filing window
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to attach an independent audit opinion renders the annual report incomplete and subject to SAMR rejection; the enterprise may then be placed on the Operating Abnormal List with consequential credit rating damage; the tax authority may likewise disregard unaudited financial statements; misrepresented audit findings may expose the auditor and the enterprise to administrative penalties and criminal liability for false certification.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Every Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise (WFOE) constituted as a limited liability company is compulsorily subject to an annual independent certified CPA audit, irrespective of balance-sheet size, annual turnover, or headcount, because the State Administration for Market Regulation requires an audited financial report to accompany the annual enterprise information disclosure. There is no audit-exemption safe harbour for WFOEs; quantitative triggers applicable to other business vehicles under the Company Law, financial supervision rules, or state-owned asset rules only impose incremental audit layers, and none relieve a WFOE of the core statutory annual audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: China Accounting Standards (Chinese GAAP / CAS), substantially converged with IFRS; Small and Micro Enterprise Accounting Standards may be used for bookkeeping where eligible, but the statutory annual audit and annual report disclosure must nevertheless follow CAS-based financial reporting parameters accepted by regulatory authorities.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: China does not maintain a standalone permanent UBO registry, but the annual enterprise information publicity report requires disclosure of actual controllers, shareholder contributions, and shareholding structures. Any transfer of shares, change in registered capital, replacement of actual controllers, or change of legal representative/directors must be filed with SAMR within 30 days of the occurrence. The annual confirmation cycle runs from 1 January to 30 June; disclosures made by 30 June constitute the official yearly confirmation. Non-disclosure or false beneficial-ownership information triggers inclusion in the Operating Abnormal List, administrative fines up to RMB 30,000.00, and possible restrictions on the legal representative.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Qualifying High and New Technology Enterprises may use 15% preferential rate; qualified small low-profit enterprises on taxable income up to RMB 3 million benefit from an effective 5% rate through 2027; additional 100% deduction for qualified R&D expenditure; certain encouraged free-trade zone industries may access further local incentives and accelerated depreciation, provided the entity retains actual management and operational substance in China.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Enterprise Income Tax Annual Return Form A (A100000 series and supporting schedules) filed through the State Taxation Administration electronic tax bureau portal, with quarterly prepayment declarations submitted through the same system using CIT quarterly instalment forms.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual final return plus quarterly interim prepayments
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual return must be filed within five months after the fiscal year-end, i.e., by 31 May for a calendar-year WFOE; quarterly prepayments are due within 15 days after each quarter-end, with the final settlement reconciling prepayments at year end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1: Basic taxpayer identification and registration particulars
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: EIN / Unified Social Credit Code, legal name in English and original registration, registration address, tax registration status, legal representative, accounting standard.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact WFOE identification code matching the Business License; disclose immediate and ultimate foreign shareholders in the ownership schedule. For failure to update foreign shareholder changes, the tax file becomes inconsistent and outbound dividend relief may be denied.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2: Type of enterprise, industry code, and business scope
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Select resident enterprise and industry classification ISIC 7420 / NAICS 541922 corresponding to stock photography and AI-generated visual asset licensing.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare the activity as digital content licensing rather than retail trading. If stock photo income is sourced from Chinese customers, it is domestic-source income; if the WFOE licenses content to overseas affiliates, the transaction must be priced at arm's length and separately disclosed to avoid TP adjustments.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3: Revenue / total income (Lines 1 to 5 of A100000)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross sales, service fees, royalties, subscription fees, and other operating income, plus non-operating income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include all booking income recognised under PRC GAAP or IFRS, including PayPal/Stripe settlement before bank clearing. For cross-border stock photo sales booked by foreign seller-of-record entities, assess whether the Chinese WFOE is the beneficial owner of the income and whether China-source royalty or service income should be reclassified to the Chinese entity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4: Deductible costs, operating expenses, and R&D deductions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of sales, employee compensation, rent, technology infrastructure costs, royalties paid, marketing expenses, R&D expense, depreciation and amortisation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Entertainment expenses are capped at 60% of the amount and five per thousand of revenue; advertising expenses are deductible up to 15% of revenue for a service enterprise, with excess carried forward. R&D expenditure qualifies for a 100% additional deduction if the photo AI technology is substantive and properly documented. Cross-border management fees paid to offshore headquarters are deductible only if actually incurred, attributable to the Chinese activity, and evidenced by contracts; WHT obligations are separate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 5: Tax adjustments and accounting-to-taxable-income reconciliation (Schedule A105000)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Reconcile accounting profit to taxable income by adding disallowable expenses, deductible losses, and timing differences.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Adjust for unpaid withholding taxes, non-deductible tax penalties, excessive related-party service fees, and thin-capitalisation interest. For failing to deduct a fictitious stock photo software expense, the tax authority will add the amount back and assess penalties.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 6: Taxable income and tax rate / tax payable (Lines 20 to 24)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after loss carryforward and 25% income tax rate, reduced by preferential rate calculations and foreign tax credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If using a 15% high-tech enterprise rate, ensure the certificate and core IP are in force. For WFOEs with non-resident shareholders, dividend distribution amount and accounting retained earnings should not reduce taxable income and do not constitute deductible items. Quarterly prepayments are based on estimated taxable income; underpayment triggers interest.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 7: Foreign-source income and foreign tax credit schedule
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Report foreign-sourced stock photo licensing or platform income earned by the WFOE through overseas subsidiaries or branches.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: China resident WFOE is taxed on worldwide income. Foreign taxes are creditable only if the taxpayer can evidence actual payment and the foreign income is included in Chinese taxable income. State the per-country limitation to avoid double counting tax paid in a no-tax jurisdiction.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 8: Withholding tax, attribution-of-profits, and DTA relief schedule for outbound distributions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-resident shareholder dividend, interest, royalty, and fee remittances together with final withholding settlement and treaty relief claims.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: When the WFOE declares a dividend to its non-resident parent, it acts as withholding agent. Without an approved treaty benefit certificate, the gross dividend is subject to 10% final WHT. Attach the tax residency certificate, a beneficial ownership declaration and substantial operating evidence, and the board resolution declaring the dividend. No withholding is due when profits are not distributed to a non-resident in the filing year.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing without reasonable cause is fined up to RMB 2,000, and up to RMB 10,000 in serious circumstances. Late payment bears daily interest at 0.05% of the unpaid tax. Underreporting subject to Article 63 of the Tax Collection and Administration Law triggers a penalty of 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax. Criminal tax evasion reaching the statutory threshold, generally RMB 100,000 and 10% of the total tax due, is punishable under Criminal Law Article 201 with imprisonment up to seven years and fines up to five times the evaded tax; public exposure and blacklisting follow criminal conviction.
